description: This file contains a Redux reducer for managing dashboard filter state in a Superset frontend application. It defines interfaces, initial states, action handlers, and logic for updating filters, filter scopes, and related dashboard filter data.

classes.name: FilterScope
classes.description: Interface representing the scope and immune list for a dashboard filter.

classes.name: DashboardFilterEntry
classes.description: Interface representing a single dashboard filter's data and configuration.

classes.name: DashboardFiltersState
classes.description: Type representing the collection of all dashboard filters keyed by chart ID.

classes.name: DashboardFilterAction
classes.description: Interface for actions dispatched to update dashboard filters.

methods.name: dashboardFiltersReducer
methods.description: Main reducer function handling various actions to update dashboard filter state.
